name: Meridian Munitions Holdout-380 'Ankle Biter'
description:
The Meridian Munitions Holdout-380 is a micro-compact semi-automatic pistol chambered in .380 ACP, designed to be the smallest functional firearm Meridian Munitions could engineer. The entire weapon is shorter than an adult's hand span and weighs less than a loaded magazine for a full-size pistol. The barrel is just over five centimeters long, and the grip accommodates exactly two fingers.

The Ankle Biter is a true last-resort weapon. Accuracy beyond arm's length is aspirational, the five-round magazine empties in seconds, and the .380 ACP round from the abbreviated barrel barely achieves minimum defensive velocity. But the weapon fits in an ankle holster, a boot, a hidden pocket sewn into a jacket lining, or taped to the underside of a desk. For people who need a gun where no gun should be, the Holdout-380 exists.

Meridian Munitions sells the Ankle Biter with an ankle holster and a marketing card that reads: 'Because plans change.' It is the best-selling backup weapon in GLMZ — carried by people who already have a proper gun and want insurance, and by people who cannot visibly carry a weapon but refuse to be completely unarmed.
specifications:
caliber: .380 ACP
effective_range: 5 meters
rate_of_fire: Semi-automatic
magazine_capacity: 5 rounds
weight: 0.24 kg
tactical_use: An absolute last-resort backup weapon for contact-distance engagements. Effective only at point-blank range against unarmored targets. The micro-compact size enables concealment in locations where no other weapon will fit. Not a primary defensive weapon under any circumstances. Best used as a surprise weapon when all other options have been exhausted.
cultural_context: The Ankle Biter is the guilty secret of GLMZ's armed population. Even people who publicly advocate for weapons restrictions often have one hidden somewhere. Its existence acknowledges a truth that polite society prefers to ignore — sometimes the only difference between survival and death is a tiny, terrible gun that nobody knew you had.
known_users: Backup weapon carriers across all tiers
story_hooks: A high-profile peace negotiation goes wrong, and the only weapon in the room is a Holdout-380 taped under the table. Five rounds, six hostile people.
Meridian Munitions introduces a ceramic-frame Holdout that passes through metal detectors — and every security agency in GLMZ simultaneously loses its mind.

physical_description.visual_profile: A diminutive, almost toy-like semi-automatic pistol with aggressive wedge geometry. The slide and frame form a unified, minimalist profile barely larger than a matchbox. Despite its small stature, it projects lethal intent through its angular, purposeful design.
physical_description.dimensions: Overall length: 10.2 cm | Height (with grip): 6.8 cm | Slide width: 1.8 cm | Barrel length: 5.1 cm
physical_description.weight_description: Feather-light and perfectly balanced for single-hand or two-finger manipulation. Feels almost insubstantial despite being fully functional, creating a psychological disconnect between its diminutive size and mechanical lethality.
physical_description.primary_material: Hardened steel slide paired with injection-molded polymer frame reinforced with steel inserts. Minimal material, maximum efficiency.
physical_description.finish: Matte black DLC (diamond-like carbon) coating on slide for corrosion resistance; flat gray polymer frame with subtle grip texture to prevent slipping despite minimal surface area.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal black slide contrasting against charcoal gray polymer frame. Small silver Meridian Munitions logo on slide serves as sole visual accent.
physical_description.grip_texture: Aggressive stippled polymer with fine cross-hatching pattern covering every millimeter of the grip, compensating for the two-finger hold with maximum friction. Feels deliberately aggressive.
distinctive_features: Integrated trigger guard merged seamlessly into frame geometry
Nodular front sight machined directly into slide — no protruding components
Five-round magazine flush with grip, creating unbroken profile
Minimal ejection port cut — just wide enough for casing extraction
Hammerless design with completely flat profile top to bottom
Micro-serrations forward of rear sight for racking with minimal hand surface
Magazine release recessed into grip to prevent accidental ejection
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Meridian Munitions logo and 'HOLDOUT-380' stamped in shallow relief on left slide. Serial number engraved on right frame beneath slide. 'ANKLE BITER' embossed on grip panel in small capitals.
physical_description.condition_typical: Well-maintained and clean — carried as insurance, not primary armament. Typical examples show light handling marks on grip texture but pristine bore and mechanism. Often appears with factory-fresh appearance despite years of concealed carry.
